verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing pages claim built-in AI features ('Get answers, instantly—with citations' and 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents'), indicating a native AI assistant/agent capability, but these are vendor-only claims with no independent or hands-on corroboration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: hands-on/community validation of the AI assistant's actual task-delegation behavior, details on scope/limits of agent autonomy, and independent reviews confirming reliability.
